title: Set approval levels that match a real company — on Set up Sales itself

steps.do: Sales home → "Set up Sales" → section "Approving a quote" → "Who approves, and up to what value".
steps.expect: One card per level (Level · From value · Up to value (0 = no limit) · Approved by (role) · …or one named person · For · In use · Save · Remove), and a dashed card at the end with "Add this level".
steps.observed: No levels yet ("No levels yet. Add the first one:"); the dashed card (dashed) offers Level · From value · Up to value (0 = no limit) · Approved by (role) · …or one named person · For · In use and "Add this level". (A saved level's card adds Save and Remove — seen from step 2.)

steps.do: In the dashed card: Level 1, From 0, Up to 500000, Approved by "Branch Manager", For "Every business unit". Press "Add this level".
steps.expect: You stay on Set up Sales. A card "Level 1" appears, and the summary above reads "Level 1 — from ₹0 to ₹5,00,000 before tax: Branch Manager."
steps.observed: Stayed on Set up Sales; card "Level 1" with Save and Remove; summary "Level 1 — from ₹0 to ₹5,00,000 before tax: Branch Manager."

steps.do: Look at the new dashed card.
steps.expect: It is already filled in: Level 2, From 500000 — where level 1 stops.
steps.observed: The dashed card already holds Level 2, From 500000.

steps.do: Level 2: Up to 2500000, Approved by "Marketing Manager". Add this level.
steps.expect: Card "Level 2"; summary line "Level 2 — above ₹5,00,000 to ₹25,00,000 before tax: Marketing Manager."
steps.observed: Card "Level 2"; summary "Level 2 — above ₹5,00,000 to ₹25,00,000 before tax: Marketing Manager."

steps.do: Level 3: From 2500000, Up to 0, Approved by "Business Director". Add this level.
steps.expect: Card "Level 3"; summary says "above ₹25,00,000". The line "Nothing above … is covered" disappears, and a line reads "A quote goes up the levels: it is signed by the level its value falls in and by every level below it, in order."
steps.observed: Card "Level 3"; "above ₹25,00,000"; the "Nothing above" line disappeared; "A quote goes up the levels…" is shown.

steps.do: Edge: in the dashed card type From 900000 and Up to 800000. Add this level.
steps.expect: Refused: "The "up to" value must be above the "from" value (or 0 for no upper limit)." No card is added.
steps.observed: Refused: "The "up to" value must be above the "from" value (or 0 for no upper limit)."; still three cards.

steps.do: Change Level 1's "Approved by" to "Business Unit Head" and press that card's Save. Then change it back to Branch Manager and Save.
steps.expect: Each save stays on Set up Sales; the summary follows the change.
steps.observed: Each save stayed on Set up Sales; the summary followed: Level 1 — from ₹0 to ₹5,00,000 before tax: Business Unit Head. → Level 1 — from ₹0 to ₹5,00,000 before tax: Branch Manager.

steps.expect: The same three levels, named "Level 1 — Branch Manager", "Level 2 — Marketing Manager", "Level 3 — Business Director".
steps.observed: Approval rules lists Level 1 — Branch Manager, Level 2 — Marketing Manager, Level 3 — Business Director.

steps.do: Edge: in the dashed card type Level 4, From 30000, Up to 100000 (inside Level 1). Add this level.
steps.expect: Refused: "Level 1 already covers ₹0 to ₹5,00,000. Levels may not overlap — a quotation moves up through them in order…". No card is added.
steps.observed: Refused: "Level 1 already covers ₹0 to ₹5,00,000. Levels may not overlap — a quotation moves up through them in order. Start this level at ₹5,00,000, or change level 1 first."

steps.do: Edge: type Level 1, From 3000000, Up to 0 (a higher range with a lower level number). Add this level.
steps.expect: Refused: "A higher value needs a higher level number…". No card is added.
steps.observed: Refused: "A higher value needs a higher level number: level 1 covers ₹0 to ₹5,00,000, so this range must be level 2 or above."

steps.do: As Test BDM make three quotations — ₹2,00,000, ₹10,00,000 and ₹30,00,000 before tax — and submit each for approval. Open each one's approval steps.
steps.expect: ₹2,00,000: Level 1 only. ₹10,00,000: Level 1, then Level 2. ₹30,00,000: Level 1 → Level 2 → Level 3 (one after another, or all at once if Set up Sales says so).
steps.observed: ₹2,00,000: Level 1 (now with level 1; "Submitted for approval — 1 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager).") | ₹10,00,000: Level 1 → Level 2 (now with level 1; "Submitted for approval — 2 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager); th") | ₹30,00,000: Level 1 → Level 2 → Level 3 (now with level 1; "Submitted for approval — 3 step(s). Now with Test BranchMgr (Branch Manager); th")
